_doc: 프로파일별 적대 리뷰 정책. 기본 Claude/Codex 프로파일은 같은 도구 계열의 headless 리뷰만 사용하며, 다른 공급자 계정은 요구하지 않는다.

tier_policy._doc: naia-agent 원조 2계층의 하네스 정규화. 머리쓰기·설계·실질검증=상위(플래그십) / 형식검증=하위(라이트) / 구조=결정론(LLM 무).

profile_policy.selection: Use only the active host profile's reviewer by default. Cross-profile adapters are downstream opt-in overrides.
profile_policy.unavailable: Record external review as NOT_RUN and continue ordinary deterministic validation; never require another CLI installation or provider account. A governed delivery that explicitly requires independent review remains REVIEW_ONLY until evidence exists.

degradation._doc: No first output before startup timeout, output silence after idle timeout, or the total cap triggers R-1 degradation with the exact phase recorded.
degradation.on_timeout: drop reviewer and continue; at R=0 record NOT_RUN without blocking ordinary work

excluded.gemini-cli: 응답 5분+ 불안정 (2026-05-30 실측). 검증층은 timeout+graceful degradation 필요. 속도·신뢰 필요 시 Vertex 등 유료 API 옵션.
